args.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: SIX existing tactical-map walking poses of a young village militia swordsman, arranged TWO columns and THREE rows. Image2 is the APPROVED character and palette reference. Edit Image1 to match the exact blue-white FLAT material style of Image2 while preserving the six walking actions, facing directions and leg silhouettes in Image1. Output ONE transparent sprite sheet, TWO columns and THREE rows, six COMPLETE figures with generous margins and no touching.
Exact layout/actions: TOP ROW shows moving UP/AWAY, rear view, two alternating leg phases: left first phase and right second phase. MIDDLE ROW shows walking to the RIGHT, same right-facing upper body and short sword, left pose bent raised forward knee, right pose extended stride. BOTTOM ROW shows moving DOWN/toward viewer, same front-view upper body, two alternating raised knees. Keep the original arm and short-sword poses in each row. Never change direction or substitute an idle stance. Each pose must have two fully connected arms, two legs and boots.
Exact color/style changes: hair ONE solid matte medium BROWN, no highlights, no shine, no bright flecks. Main vest and sash BLUE #3976b5 matching approved idle, dark blue #172638 outlines/shadows, soft WHITE #e4e1c8 shirt/sleeves and trousers, dark navy boots. No orange sash, no brown vest, no grey pants. Natural peach skin and simple steel short sword. FLAT pixel art: no glossy or sparkly highlights on hair/clothing, no gradient rendering, no blur, no lighting effects. Keep the approved spiky-haired youthful identity, plain unarmored vest/white undershirt, white trousers and blue sash; no armor, cloak, hat, bow or extra equipment.
Animation registration: the two figures of EACH ROW have exactly the SAME head size, SAME body scale, SAME head/torso height and SAME horizontal center relative to their cell. No overall bobbing, leaning or swaying. The original legs change below the stable waist, and original arm gestures remain. White trousers, boots, hips and sash must remain continuous in each complete drawing. Preserve readable outlines and modest soft saturation; palette stays lively, not muddy or grey. No text, labels, ground/shadows or decorations.
